workflow.feature_vocabulary: learned on each training fold only
workflow.gnn_representation: gene-level union of functional annotations; disease identifiers excluded
workflow.shared_hpo_budget: selected on S3 training-only nested CV and frozen identically for S2 and S3
workflow.feature_selection: repeated inside nested grouped training CV
workflow.calibration: adaptive isotonic-or-sigmoid fitted after validation selection; ordinal boundaries are atomic with explicit raw fallback
workflow.test_policy: single evaluation of one frozen model/calibrator per scenario
workflow.missingness: pair-preserving left joins; unknown values preserved until training-fold median imputation with source indicators
workflow.mi_leakage_policy: MI is selection/audit only; leakage exclusions use provenance rules

target_label_provenance: Severity labels were assigned by an evidence-grounded artificial-intelligence agent operationalising the Lazarin and ACMG severity framework from published phenotype evidence, with concordance reported against expert-curated cohorts; they are not case-by-case expert adjudications. HPO-aware scenarios therefore assess reproducibility and internal generalisation of phenotype-informed curation, not validation against a phenotype-independent outcome.

S1_Mechanistic.rationale: organ-criticality columns share a source with the severity label; n_inheritance_modes and has_mixed_inheritance are gene-level rollups over the gene's disease set and act as disease-count proxies, which is out of scope for a gene-intrinsic scenario. Mode-of-inheritance columns are retained.

all_scenarios.rationale: gene_age is an exact linear function of conservation_score. Other broken or duplicate inputs are removed at load; see removed_input_columns.
all_scenarios.inheritance: pair-specific, from the primary file column moi_title
